snippet.title: CH13: Rest Stop - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Rest Stop is a short narrative-driven psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren’t prepared for.

Wishlist now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3927170/CH13_Rest_Stop/
